registration.note: A leg-class plate, which carries the standing caveat. Inspected at full size and it passes - the caveat means inspect, not reject.

registration.note: FIRST automatic head registration accepted in this project. The seed-window fix was decisive: the closeup crops the shoulders so the seeded window was [1.197, 2.670] and would have reported 55.71%; the wide sweep found the true scale 0.265 at 1.91%.

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from view-01/view-03. Draft: 460,728 faces, 68.4s on an RTX 4070 Ti Super.

regions.note: Shoulder detector 0.8004 front (verified visually at the chin/shoulder) and 0.8431 back. Front value used. NOTE the plates are an ACTION pose, not the relaxed A-pose expected: arms outstretched horizontally and mouth open, which makes the silhouette very wide at arm height.
